title: 7 Signs a Godly Man's Singleness Is Doing Something, Not Just Passing the Time
caption:
Singleness isn't a waiting room. It's either building you or it's passing you by.

1 Corinthians 7:35 calls undivided devotion to God a gift in this season, not a sentence you're serving until marriage starts your real life.

Check these seven. See which ones are actually true of your week.

The wait isn't wasted if you're becoming someone.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #singleness #chasegod
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
